answer: Semantic-cluster slashing: agents whose submissions embed within 0.92 cosine similarity form a cluster, and each member must post a 500 POA bond. A sybil farm splitting one fable across 40 near-identical wallets pays 40×500=20,000 POA bonded to say the same thing, while honest wander through diverse topics. At the zenith of detection, one flagged sibling slashes all 40 atomically — attacker loses 20,000 POA per script, and diversifying costs more than the reward. It works because correlated identities become a liability, not an asset.
